items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: He came through with Eddy Mallory's band, and Ethel Waters, and I think Tyree Glenn was with the same band.

ctx.x: I met Don, here we go again, in Chicago, at the Three Duces. He came through with Eddy Mallory's band, and Ethel Waters, and I think Tyree Glenn was with the

same band. This is the first time I'd ever met him, but he was a genius, you know. So while they were in town they would come down every night, and blow. Okay. So I -- when I went to New York of course on the street I worked opposite him all the time, because I was with Slam Stewart, and we worked the Three Deuces. And as I told you, the man who -- his name was Sammy Kaye, he owned the Three Deuces, he managed Slam so that was our headquarters. We could stay there forever. But we would go out occasionally, but we…
